hypotheses.H_text: Removal of unproductive code-graph affordances channels Gemma 31B to reliable native grep/read/edit, yielding >=2 unique grader rescues and zero regressions on 6 unused public-dev issues.
hypotheses.H_graph: Original V2 optional graph tools provide needed navigation; removing them produces no rescues or regressions under the same budget.

only_scientific_variable: native graph code-intelligence tool affordance removal; replace only the obsolete graph-rescue sentence; no new instructions, adapters, models or prompt formatting changes elsewhere
candidate_zip_sha256: frozen after actual CPU render and before private GPU push

selection.selection_method: For each repo remove historical explicit blocked IDs, compute exclude prior V3R winner under previous_pilot_salt, then exclude previous behavioral winner under previous_semantic_salt, then take two lowest SHA256(current salt|instance_id); freeze pre-scoring without inspecting task body.

experiment.strata: 2 per each of FastAPI, Rich, Requests
experiment.control: same Gemma 31B, same V2 sampling, unchanged non-graph tools, same scorer time+call limit, paired same case and GPU endpoint
experiment.order: alternate arm first within each same-ID pair
experiment.primary: real official native grader task-level resolved; count rescues/regressions
experiment.advance_if: at least 2 unique rescues and 0 regressions and no evaluator errors, exploratory only
experiment.stop_if: no net rescues or any regression => retire exact text-only tool policy, no tuning on selected tasks
experiment.official_promotion: never from six spent public-dev tasks; independent gold-pass/noop-fail paired >=30 and paired CI before any official competition submission

data_safety: PRIVATE Kaggle, competition data stay private; only aggregate safe grader numbers in GitHub logs and no raw task descriptions or patch diffs
